items.title: Cummins (CMI) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut As Analysts Trim Growth And Margin Views
items.summary: Cummins is working through a reset in expectations as fair value in updated models moves from US$721.14 to US$662.35. Analysts trimming price targets also describe a mixed setup, with some highlighting room for the stock if earnings delivery and capital allocation stay on track, while others focus on questions around longer term power systems and truck demand. items.title: CMI Q3 2026 deep dive: data center demand and supply constraints shape outlook
items.summary: Engine manufacturer Cummins (NYSE:CMI) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales rose 13.5% year on year to $9.44 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $8.25 per share was 0.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
